definitions: To create an unpleasant memory or impression.
To cause a feeling of disgust, disappointment, or resentment.
examples: The way they handled the layoffs really left a bad taste in the mouth.
His rude comments at the meeting left a bad taste in the mouth for everyone present.
Despite the good food, the high price left a bad taste in the mouth.
lemma: leave a bad taste in the mouth
source: leave a bad taste in the mouth
